title: Enhancing colonic health with encapsulated grape seed anthocyanins: Oral capsule for Colon-targeted delivery.
authors: Niu, Ben; Gao, Wenyu; Li, Feng; Pei, Zhangming; Wang, Hongchao; Tian, Fengwei; Zhao, Jianxin; Lu, Wenwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究封装葡萄籽花青素的口服胶囊对结肠炎的治疗效果，属于食品递送与肠道疾病模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Grape seed anthocyanins (GSA) offer health benefits and protect against diseases, including colitis. Its unpleasant smell and instability prevent widespread application. Antisolvent pretreatment GSA was encapsulated in chitosan-phytic acid 3D gel network. SEM and X-ray diffraction results demonstrate that pretreatment reduces GSA particle size and exhibits amorphous structure. FTIR confirmed they were physically encapsulated and not covalently bound. Its subsequent simulations digestion and fermentation showed only 26.69 % upper digestive tract leakage and altered gut microbiota and metabolites profile. In DSS-induced colitis model, it ameliorated the symptoms, including diarrhea, bloody stools, weight loss, and DAI score. Additionally, it regulates colitis mice pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines, modifies cecum and colon SCFA profile, improves intestinal barrier, and restores colonic cell redox equilibrium. Collectively, GSA ameliorates experimental colitis via inhibiting TRL4/NF-kappaB and activating Nrf2 signaling pathway. In conclusion, we propose our GSA capsule can effectively deliver an intact parent form of GSA to the colon and has the potential to be a colonic health strategy.
abstract_zh: 葡萄籽花青素（GSA）具有健康益处并能预防包括结肠炎在内的疾病，但其不良气味和不稳定性限制了其广泛应用。采用反溶剂预处理GSA并将其封装于壳聚糖-植酸三维凝胶网络中。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和X射线衍射结果表明，预处理减小了GSA的粒径并呈现无定形结构。傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）证实其被物理封装而非共价结合。随后的模拟消化和发酵实验显示，仅26.69%在上消化道泄漏，并改变了肠道微生物群和代谢物谱。在DSS诱导的结肠炎模型中，它改善了症状，包括腹泻、血便、体重减轻和疾病活动指数（DAI）评分。此外，它调节结肠炎小鼠的促炎和抗炎细胞因子，改变盲肠和结肠短链脂肪酸（SCFA）谱，改善肠道屏障，并恢复结肠细胞氧化还原平衡。总体而言，GSA通过抑制TRL4/NF-kappaB和激活Nrf2信号通路改善实验性结肠炎。总之，我们提出我们的GSA胶囊能有效将完整母体形式的GSA递送至结肠，并具有作为结肠健康策略的潜力。
